evidence_items.locator: Investigation of SGE-recommended sites, paragraph beginning What makes this trickier
evidence_items.explanation: The outlet tested recommended sites and encountered scams and unwanted software, supporting a concrete reliability concern. Google said the examples involved uncommon queries and had been removed; this investigation supplies no representative error rate for generative search generally.

evidence_items.locator: Philipp Schindler's prepared remarks on Search advertising
evidence_items.explanation: Alphabet describes an identifiable advertising approach and favorable early feedback, which weighs against treating generative search as lacking any commercial direction. The disclosure does not connect SGE advertising returns to its delivery costs, so it does not establish or disprove viability under the contract.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved first-quarter investigation documents serious failures but not their prevalence across ordinary queries and products.
No retrieved commercial evidence establishes whether generative-search monetization could sustainably cover its relevant costs in the target period.
Missing public cost data cannot itself prove that no clear viable business model existed.
